correctness.rationale: The center line is recovered intrinsically from (Ann(E²))², since B restricted to s⊥ has rank m−1 or m−2≥1. In the nonresonant case anisotropic orthogonal splitting forces u³=1 and gives μ3×O(s⊥). In the resonant case a hyperbolic-plane decomposition yields an explicit bijective parabolic parametrization and the exact GO multiplier fibre count. Orthogonal-order signs follow from determinants, and the 5 complete small-field enumerations agree.

value.rationale: The full automorphism group of a fundamental nonperfect graph evolution algebra is a natural invariant. The theorem determines its isomorphism type or explicit parabolic coordinates and its order for every star size and odd prime power, with a sharp modular change at p|m. It separates genuine algebra automorphisms from graph symmetries (q=5,m=3: 12 versus 6) and provides exact finite-field targets for further orbit and derivation studies; these are not arbitrary finite slices.
